CoreWeave dipped as traders cashed in some of their chips following the stock's massive gains a day earlier. Fellow neocloud play Nebius tumbled after lifting its 2026 forecast for capital expenditures spending. Follow along as CNBC highlights the biggest stock market moves of the day. 38 Min Ago Super Micro drops after Bloomberg reports DOJ is investigating whether Alice Huang was involved in smuggling products The maker of data center servers fell on Thursday after Bloomberg News reported, citing a person familiar, that the Justice Department is looking into whether Alice Huang helped smuggle Super Micro Computer's products. Super Micro was last down more than 9%. Super Micro Computer on Thursday Alice Huang is the woman with whom former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had had an affair . U.S. intelligence officials also believe her to be a Chinese spy. -- Darla Mercado 2 Hours Ago Yeti extends slump to third day after Q3 revenue missed, full-year guidance cut Yeti tumblers are displayed at an REI store on May 09, 2024 in Berkeley, California. Justin Sullivan | Getty Images Austin, Texas-based Yeti Holdings sank 8%, extending a three-day decline, after third-quarter adjusted revenue of $517.9 million missed Wall Street analyst estimates of $523 million and the cooler and travel mug maker lowered full-year forecasts for earnings per share excluding one-time items, adjusted revenue and adjusted operating income. Yeti has now tumbled 14% in three days and more than 22% in the past three months. — Scott Schnipper 3 Hours Ago CoreWeave slides the day after huge post-earnings advance The New Jersey-based neocloud provider sank almost 8%, one day after soaring 25% in the wake of better-than-expected third-quarter results. TTWO- YTD In the past, GTA 5 had surpassed $1 billion in sales (gross of platform/channel fees) within its first three days. Intel is struggling with delays and supply shortages for its next-generation Xeon processor. At Nvidia, the potential departure of CEO Jensen Huang who's embroiled in extramarital scandal could benefit AMD over a multi-year period.
